messages:
Maya: Heads-up: dashboard spiked on rtf-latency around 09:12 PT. Need a quick preflight/readout before tomorrow's infra sync. Can folks jump on a 30m slot today?
Liam: Link to dashboard: https://redwood-internal/dashboard/latency?range=1h :eyes: I see p50 fine but p99 jumped ~120ms.
Sophia: I can do 3:30pm PT. What do you want covered? baseline numbers, quantization effects, canary plan?
Maya: @Sophia baseline + change log + a small canary plan. Also a quick checklist: reproduce, perf-harness run, collect flamegraphs, validate logits drift.
Ravi: I can be there 4:00pm PT. Add me. Also adding the perf command we'll run so folks can pre-run locally: ```./harness/run_bench --model redwood-v2-small --seq 1024 --iters 200 --batch 1 --trace=flame```
Maya: Perfect. @Noah can you bring the trace from the 09:12 spike? need KV cache stats and p99 breakdown.
Noah: Uploading logs now. S3 link: s3://redwood-prod/perf-spikes/1768872210/ :arrow_up: Will also attach KV cache dump and the node-level p99 CSV.
eng-bot: Reminder: please add agenda to meeting doc: https://docs.redwood.dev/syncs/infer-preflight (auto-created)
Liam: Agenda proposal: 1) spike root-cause hypotheses 2) reproduce run (local + infra) 3) canary rollout plan + fallback 4) short action items + owners
Sophia: If reproductions are flaky, add a fallback: run on dedicated pool with quantized model variant, and capture exact seed/inputs.
Maya: Time chosen: 16:00 PT (23:00 UTC). Invite sent. Recording enabled. Please set Zoom to admit only org users.
Ravi: :thumbsup: I'll prep a short perf notebook and a few comparison graphs (baseline vs current).
Noah: Logs uploaded + small snippet of the nginx config that changed yesterday: ```server_tokens off; keepalive_timeout 60; proxy_buffering on;```
Maya: Thanks. For the preflight: please attach any small repro dataset (<=10 queries) and the commit hash you ran against. If you run the harness, attach the raw traces.
Liam: I'll post the runtime commit: abc123def and the PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4242 (runtime scheduler tweak).
Sophia: Noted. If someone can't make it, drop notes in thread and we can async the readout — we'll triage action items in the doc.
Maya: @eng-oncall FYI in case we need escalation during canary. Also we'll want a short rollback playbook in the doc.
eng-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll standby and can trigger the canary circuit-breaker if latency regressions exceed threshold.
Maya: One more: please run a quick KV-warmup before the benchmark to avoid cold-cache noise. Add the warmup command to the meeting doc if you run it.
Ravi: Will do. Posting warmup snippet here: ```python warmup.py --pool dedicated --queries=50```
Noah: Also attached the small repro set to the meeting doc and marked which inputs hit long-context paths.
Maya: Great — see you all at 16:00 PT. If anything urgent pops up, ping this thread and we'll re-evaluate start time.
